note: Draft-night evidence only for the 2005 NBA Draft class: identity, pre-draft camp measurements, last pre-draft season statistics and pre-draft mock-draft slots. ranking_unavailable: web.archive.org is unreachable from this environment, so no archived NBADraft.net, DraftExpress or NBA.com pages dated before 2005-06-28 could be read.
ESPN pages (Chad Ford's 2005 big board and mock, Dick Vitale's June 26, 2005 mock) return a bot challenge; not reachable.
NBADraft.net's 2005 mock page and DraftExpress's 2005 mock return 404 / empty responses; no two-round 2005 mock was found, so no second-round slots exist for the class.
RealGM and ProSportsTransactions return 403 to this environment.
